note: Everyday words -> the wording the city FAQ uses, appended to the request before it is embedded for FAQ retrieval (faq.expand; e5 does not connect 大包垃圾 with 巨大垃圾(大型廢棄物)). Each alias: a Python regular expression over the request (re.search) and the FAQ words appended when it matches, in this order. Moved from faq.COLLOQUIAL to data on 2026-11-16 (need-style step 6, rules section 6) without changing behaviour; a new alias is data only.

aliases.pattern: (?:大型|大件|大包|巨大|粗大|家戶|大的).{0,4}垃圾|垃圾.{0,4}(?:大型|大件|大包|巨大|粗大)|舊(?:家具|沙發|床墊|衣櫃|桌子|椅子)|(?:家具|沙發|床墊|衣櫃)(?:要|怎麼|如何|可以)?.{0,3}(?:丟|回收|清運|收)
aliases.words: 巨大垃圾 大型廢棄物 收運
aliases.note: 大型家戶垃圾, 大包垃圾, 家裡的大件垃圾, 舊沙發, 粗大垃圾 ... -> the FAQ's 巨大垃圾(大型廢棄物)

aliases.pattern: 垃圾車|倒垃圾|丟垃圾|垃圾.{0,3}(?:幾點|時間)
aliases.words: 垃圾車 收運時間 清運

aliases.pattern: 身[分份]證.{0,3}(?:掉|不見|遺失|弄丟|丟了)
aliases.words: 身分證 遺失 補發
